Mid-morning, bulletin for readers
Please give it some attention
Urgent Notice for Travelers With Companion Animals

Travelers using Aurelia Skyways must review their pet arrangements before arrival, as the Companion Animal Travel Desk is now handling close checks on all companion animal bookings. Please bring all papers, carriers, and handling details in order so your journey can proceed without avoidable delay.

Please note that reptile transport is subject to the stated fee and the applicable desk review applies before acceptance. <<FACT F060>> Any traveler bringing a rabbit must also confirm that the pet and crate meet the permitted combined limit. <<FACT F064>> If a record is incomplete, the desk will pause the case and ask for correction before the animal can continue through the process.

This review is being handled in a calm stepwise manner, but urgent attention is still required from travelers. Keep your animal secure, follow all guidance from ground staff, and prepare to answer screening questions clearly and promptly. If your companion animal appears unsettled, inform staff at once so the case can be reviewed in the proper order and with due care.

For immediate assistance, please report to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once.
